3951.title: Large timeline responses bypass reuse
3951.rootCauseOneLine: The 200-row admission gate leaves larger responses uncached, so identical keys invoke the projection callback again.
3951.proposedFix: Define a bounded memory policy for large responses before replacing the row admission gate.
3951.caveats: Pure cache reproduction plus static route tracing; production CPU and hit rate were not measured. Normal build blocked by a broken local pnpm launcher.
